items.title: STERIS (NYSE:STE) posts better-than-expected sales in Q3 CY2026, stock soars
items.summary: Medical equipment and services company Steris (NYSE:STE) announced better-than-expected revenue in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q2 2027), with revenue up 8.8% year on year to $1.59 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.94 per share was 9.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
